thread:
nina-partnerships: Heads up — AuroraRack's PO (AR-PO-721) got rejected by our procurement flow. Vendor portal flagged currency+vat mismatch for APAC shipment.

sophie-sales: They submitted PO in SGD but our contract and MSA list USD as billing currency. AuroraRack says SG entity will invoice locally.

josh-finance: If the invoice is issued by a Singapore entity we need their GST registration (UEN + GST reg no) to reclaim VAT/GST. Also our payment rails differ for SGD.

tara-legal: Did they switch invoicing entity or is this a bill-to vs remit-to difference? If it's a different legal entity, we need an executed amendment or a supplier onboarding doc showing the SG entity is part of the same corporate group.

aurorarack-rep: Hi team — correct, AuroraRack APAC (AuroraRack Pte Ltd) will invoice for shipments to SG customers. We can provide local invoice and GST number, but we didn't realize Redwood's PO template enforces USD. Our portal created the PO in SGD by default. Apologies.

mike-ops: For hardware provisioning and customs, we need the exact ship-to entity and tax ID. Customs paperwork will be delayed without matching billing details. Could block fulfillment for 7–10 days.

josh-finance: We can accept SGD invoices but need: (1) vendor GST reg no, (2) entity name exactly as on bank account, (3) bank SWIFT/IBAN or local Singapore banking details. Also confirm if they accept wire in USD to a SG bank or need SGD credit.

sophie-sales: AuroraRack, can you confirm which legal name will sign the commercial invoice and provide a sample invoice PDF?

aurorarack-rep: Sending sample_invoice_AR_SG.pdf via vendor-bot now. Legal name: AuroraRack Pte Ltd. GST reg: 2026-SG-998877. Bank: DBS Bank — SGD A/C. They prefer SGD local transfer.

vendor-bot: [system] Uploaded: sample_invoice_AR_SG.pdf, gst_certificate_aurorarack.pdf.

josh-finance: Uploaded docs look good but GST cert is a scanned image — need a certificate with UEN match. Also our APAC payment team requires beneficiary name match exactly with the PO. PO will need to be re-issued with AuroraRack Pte Ltd as bill-to.
tara-legal: Given the entity change for billing, we should document the relationship between AuroraRack Inc (US) and AuroraRack Pte Ltd. A simple group confirmation letter from their controller is acceptable for procurement onboarding. For longer-term, amend the MSA to add AuroraRack Pte Ltd as an authorized invoicer.
mike-ops: If they will ship from SG to our APAC region, customs HS codes and incoterm need to be on invoice (DDP vs DAP). Which incoterm are they proposing?
aurorarack-rep: We typically ship DAP for evaluation kits. We'll update invoice to include HS 847150 and incoterm DAP.
sophie-sales: Can Sales reissue a PO referencing AuroraRack Pte Ltd and note "local invoice (SGD) — tax docs on file"? That should help finance match.
josh-finance: Yes, reissue PO with exact legal name and currency SGD, include commerce/order id, and cc finance-apac@redwood.ai. We'll set payment hold until bank verification completes.

sophie-sales: I'll create PO today: AR-PO-721-SG. Marking as "conditional — GST docs pending".
aurorarack-rep: We'll also ask our bank to send a beneficiary confirmation letter to finance-apac@redwood.ai. Expect within 24 hours.

tara-legal: I'll accept the group confirmation letter for onboarding. Drafting a short addendum clause to add AuroraRack Pte Ltd as authorized invoicer for APAC shipments — will circulate for signature.
mike-ops: Once PO is reissued and we have HS code + incoterm, I'll queue the pick/pack. ETA 2 business days after docs clear.
nina-partnerships: Action list: (1) @sophie-sales reissue PO in SGD to AuroraRack Pte Ltd; (2) @aurorarack-rep provide bank confirmation and group confirmation letter; (3) @josh-finance verify GST and bank details; (4) @tara-legal prepare addendum for APAC invoicing. We'll keep pilot fulfillment on hold until PO and docs align.
sophie-sales: PO created: AR-PO-721-SG. Sent via portal and cc'd finance-apac.
josh-finance: Received PO. Flagged hold — will verify once bank email arrives.
aurorarack-rep: Bank confirmation sent from treasury@aurorarackbank.sg — contains acct last4: 6789. Group confirmation letter uploaded.
vendor-bot: [system] Uploaded: bank_confirmation_aurorarack_sg.pdf, group_confirmation_letter.pdf.
josh-finance: Bank domain checks out. Last4 matches sample invoice. Clearing for SGD payment routing. Finance will still hold until addendum executed for production billing, but pilot fulfillment approved.
mike-ops: Good — scheduling outbound shipment for pilot kit. Tracking to be shared when dispatched.

nina-partnerships: Closing: Pilot shipment approved under AR-PO-721-SG, finance holding production release until addendum signed, legal to finalize addendum. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
